title: Octopath Traveler
subtitle: Eight starting points in Orsterra
summary: Octopath Traveler is Square Enix and Acquire's role-playing game, first released for Switch on 13 July 2018.
body: Octopath Traveler is Square Enix and Acquire's role-playing game, first released for Switch on 13 July 2018. Eight travelers begin in different parts of Orsterra, each with a personal story and a reason to leave home. The player chooses a starting protagonist and recruits the others while exploring the continent. Towns and routes connect those separate lives, letting the party grow around a first chosen viewpoint. Its HD-2D presentation gives the journeys a distinctive appearance through small character sprites placed within richly lit three-dimensional scenery.

Battles turn on breaking enemy defenses by striking weaknesses. The party can also save Boost Points and spend them to strengthen an action, connecting one turn's restraint to another turn's burst of power. Recognizing when an opponent is vulnerable matters as much as discovering the right weapon or element. The eight travelers bring different abilities to that preparation, while their actions outside combat provide ways to interact with townspeople. A useful encounter can therefore begin before a battle, through what a particular character can learn or obtain in town.

Each traveler's story unfolds across four chapters, with the initial protagonist remaining in the active party until that arc is complete. The structure lets the player follow several ambitions across the same world while developing a preferred group for combat. Yasunori Nishiki composed the score, supporting the regions and individual character themes. The success of the visual approach helped make HD-2D a recognizable style for later projects. Octopath's identity rests on that combination of illustrated intimacy, luminous scenery and a party assembled from eight different departures.
